medacap.title: Developing technicians’ professional expertise
medacap.imageAlt: MEDACAP cycle — Measure, Use, Define, Acquire, Certify, Apply, Perform
medacap.lead: MEDACAP is the 7-step methodology that structures technical skills development across the CFAO Mobility network.
paragraphs: CFAO Academy supports from the Measure step: our web app lets network teams assess their skills and use data throughout the MEDACAP cycle.
We then support each subsidiary through acquisition, certification and on-the-ground performance, aligned with business goals and plans defined upstream.

mission.title: Learning by doing
mission.imageAlt: Technicians in hands-on training on a vehicle at CFAO Academy Douala
mission.lead: At CFAO Academy, training is not theory only: each module alternates structured input and work on real vehicles or equipment.
paragraphs: Our andragogical approach starts from workshop experience. In the morning, manufacturer-certified trainers set the technical framework — procedures, safety standards, diagnostic tools. In the afternoon, trainees apply on real cases: engine removal, fault codes, system adjustments.

This rhythm builds autonomy: technicians leave with repeatable actions, not slides only. Each pathway (Toyota G3, Mitsubishi Step 2, LOVOL certification…) meets manufacturer standards while adapting to African network constraints.
Final assessments combine MCQ, timed practical cases and workshop quality checks — the same level of requirement as in factory or authorised dealership.

reseau.title: People in the field
reseau.imageAlt: CFAO Academy training network map across Africa
reseau.lead: People in the field — Key Instructors and Partner Instructor Managers — deliver training close to workshops, with manufacturer standards.
paragraphs: 18 Toyota Key Instructors (G2 / Diagnostics) run Maintenance & Repair in more than ten countries. 22 multi-brand Motors PICs and 35 Equipment development PICs support Silver / Repair pathways and technicians across the continent.
Local session or Douala centre: same assessment grids, same tools, same traceability. Decentralisation does not dilute standards.
A central hub and regional relays: fewer trips, faster upskilling, harmonised practices across the CFAO Mobility network.

pays.lead: Thirty-five territories across five regions — covered countries and developing markets per Academy mapping.

equipe.lead: Twenty-six experts across five hubs cover all brands distributed by CFAO Mobility.
